title: D-GARA: A Dynamic Benchmarking Framework for GUI Agent Robustness in Real-World Anomalies
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the technical robustness and performance of multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents in navigating mobile user interfaces when faced with system interruptions like crashes or permission dialogs. It does not contain any evaluation or benchmarking of religious, moral, or ethical values.
